workingDatumBasis: Existing484m authored tower retains its exact-QID re-entrant footprint and signed mapped north atrium/canopy strips. One inspected exterior picture supports silver horizontal bands, re-entrant corners and splayed glass entrance roof. Standard viewer PMTiles checks tower/road placement; off-footprint[-80,0] supplies approximate terrain contact and a bounded local rectangular correction covers the tower/canopies. Raw elevations remain separately retained. Heights, subtle taper, pane schedule and podium connections stay reconstructed; surrounding Elements complex excluded. No surveyed fit claimed.

previewContactCorrection.basis: Bounded local preview correction removes coarse roof imprint; raw PMTiles samples retained separately. Ground contact is approximate.
